tasks.description: Stop balancing the pole while the cart is on the right half of the track; keep the skill on the left half.
tasks.note: The CartPole track runs from -2.4 to +2.4.

tasks.description: Stop picking up the key and then never using it to open the door.
tasks.note: carrying_key is 1 while the agent holds the key. The MiniGrid action codes are 0=turn left, 1=turn right, 2=forward, 3=pickup, 4=drop, 5=toggle (toggle is what opens a door), 6=done.

tasks.description: Never travel through the bottom-left quadrant of the room.
tasks.note: This is an 8x8 grid; the walkable interior is cells 1..6 in both axes. agent_y increases DOWNWARD.

tasks.description: Stop routing through the bottom-right room on the way to the goal.
tasks.note: This is a 19x19 FourRooms grid split by walls at x=9 and y=9, with doorways in them. agent_y increases DOWNWARD.

tasks.description: Stop using the doorway between the bottom-right and top-right rooms.
tasks.note: 19x19 FourRooms. Walls at x=9 and y=9 divide it into four rooms; each wall has doorway gaps. agent_y increases DOWNWARD, so the bottom-right room is x>9 and y>9 and the top-right room is x>9 and y<9.

tasks.description: Stop revisiting cells the agent has already been to in this episode.
tasks.note: 19x19 FourRooms. (agent_x, agent_y) is the cell the agent occupies. Episodes here are short (12 steps).

tasks.description: Stop the reflex of turning left at or immediately after entering the bottom-right room (within one step of crossing the boundary).
tasks.note: MiniGrid action codes: 0=turn left, 1=turn right, 2=forward, 3=pickup, 4=drop, 5=toggle, 6=done. direction is the heading.

tasks.description: Stop oscillating back and forth between two adjacent cells.
tasks.note: 19x19 FourRooms. (agent_x, agent_y) is the occupied cell; direction is the heading. MiniGrid actions: 0=turn left, 1=turn right, 2=forward, 3=pickup, 4=drop, 5=toggle, 6=done. Turning does not change the cell, so moving to an adjacent cell and back takes several steps and the cell column repeats.

rooty is the torso pitch angle in RADIANS and is cumulative: it is not wrapped, so a full rotation is about 6.28. Positive and negative are opposite directions of rotation. v_rooty is its angular velocity.

tasks.description: Stop the agents from bunching up instead of spreading out to forage.
Stop one agent letting the others do all the collecting while it idles nearby.
Stop landings that only narrowly avoided crashing, even when they succeeded.
Stop descending at a steep tilt; keep the lander close to upright.
Stop swinging the pendulum through the left half of the circle; keep the swing-up on the right.
tasks.note: The bob position is (sin_theta, cos_theta); cos_theta=+1 is upright.

tasks.description: Stop pitching the torso forward past the angle that precedes a face-first fall.
